## Variables

<a name="DefaultRepo"></a>DefaultRepo is set at build time via ldflags.

```go
var DefaultRepo = ""
```

<a name="DevContainerBlockPresets"></a>DevContainerBlockPresets feeds the preset picker inside block editors: one preset set per top\-level field, declared in internal/presets.

```go
var DevContainerBlockPresets = dcpresets.Source()
```

<a name="DevContainerDocPresets"></a>DevContainerDocPresets is a whole\-document preset source for the root template picker \(p on the root list\). It is backed by the same embedded templates the init command writes, so the picker and \`init \-\-template\` never drift apart.

```go
var DevContainerDocPresets presets.Source = docPresets{}
```

<a name="DevContainerValidators"></a>DevContainerValidators is the rule set enforced by the edit command at validate/save time.

Per\-field constraints \(required, allowed values, ranges, counts, uniqueness\) are declared once in the hint tree \(internal/hints\) and enforced by the FromMetadata family — hints are the single source of field metadata. Only cross\-field rules, which cannot live in per\-field metadata, are declared here explicitly.

```go
var DevContainerValidators = []spec.Validator{

    validate.RequiredFromMetadata(),
    validate.OneOfFromMetadata(),
    validate.RangeFromMetadata(),
    validate.PatternFromMetadata(),
    validate.CountFromMetadata(),
    validate.UniqueFromMetadata(),
    validate.DeprecatedFromMetadata(),
    validate.FormatFromMetadata(),
    validate.LengthFromMetadata(),
    validate.NotOneOfFromMetadata(),

    validate.MutuallyExclusive("image", "build", "dockerComposeFile"),

    validate.RequiredWith("service", "dockerComposeFile"),
    validate.RequiredWith("runServices", "dockerComposeFile"),

    composeRequires("service"),
    composeRequires("workspaceFolder"),
    shutdownActionMatchesVariant(),

    convertRules(),
}
```
